line.comment: * outsourcing the crafting process from Task 0 to be passive now. Always runs on Nomad TLs. On player ships it only runs when loop production is active.
* Add-Ons 2.0.2: This task is used for loop production; for the single-order version, see Mayhem.Task.MobileFactory.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Player loop production is now 1 complete cycle at a time. Nomad mobile factories still use bulk production.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Player Mobile Factory requires the kit before starting a new cycle.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Player Loop Production always processes exactly 1 complete cycle.
* Resources are removed before products are added, so their cargo space becomes available.
* Nomads retain the original bulk-production behavior.
* we cannot craft even just 1 unit and have to wait 10min for more resources
* Nomad TLs craft 8 times faster than the player's mobile factories (1 Nomad TL equals 4 standard factories)
* Player cost was already calculated above, but recalculate here harmlessly so both paths converge.
* Nomad mobile factories require 50% fewer resources compared to the player's mobile factories.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Removing the Mobile Factory Kit pauses player production.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Once production is complete, hold the entire batch until it fits.

line.text: ' needs more free cargo space to finish mobile factory production.'

line.comment: * Nomad recyclers just continue to burn all resources away.
